title: 第23章 初入秘境第24章 气运之子
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: “不是，我这运气也是没谁了……”
林轩表示很无奈。
刚刚踏入秘境，他甚至来不及仔细观察周围环境，目光仅仅扫过一眼，发现自己置身于一片广阔无垠的平原之中。
然而，就在他想要进一步了解这个地方时，一道黑影如同闪电般迅速扑来。
吼！
定睛一看，竟是一只体型巨大、毛发如钢针般竖起的黑色巨狼，正张牙舞爪地向他扑杀过来。
这只黑狼散发着令人心悸的气息，一双妖瞳闪烁着嗜血的凶芒，透露出对林轩深深的敌意，似乎恨不得立刻将他撕成碎片。
林轩：今天这种运气，如果让他去系统抽奖的话，不得裤衩子都赔光……
这是一头王者境三重天的天星狼。
天星狼，以其惊人的速度和强大的攻击力而闻名，尤其是它所掌握的本命神通“星辰咆哮”，能够释放出极其强大的星力攻击。
此外，它还拥有稀薄的圣兽血脉，未来有可能进化为圣境的圣兽，而即使未能进阶成为圣兽，一旦成年，其实力也足以媲美尊者境的强者。
可惜林轩眼前这头天星狼，显然还未成年，不过才王者境三重天，虽然境界比林轩高，但惹到林轩它算是要倒大霉了，而代价便是……它的生命！
虽然运气不太好，一进来就被大妖盯上，让林轩很无奈，但也只是吐槽了一下，反应可一点也不慢。
在躲开了天星狼的攻击后，立马召唤出他的法器——天玄剑，一柄八阶极品尊器。
以他如今的实力还无法发挥圣器的一半威力，但如果是尊器的话，林轩却能发挥出其大部分的威力。
这也是林轩明明不缺圣剑，却不使用圣剑的原因。
“畜牲！死来！”
林轩低喝一声，便一道剑光劈了过去。
破晓！
这是林轩这个月从混沌剑诀中，习得的剑招中的其中一式。
面对不过才王者境三重天的天星狼，他这一剑并未用尽全力，甚至连一半都不到，不过只用了三分力罢了。
只见那道剑光，闪烁着极其耀眼的光芒，仿佛能破开无尽混沌，照亮无尽宇宙一般。
剑光速度极快，直指天星狼。
而此时的天星狼却是发现它平时引以为傲的速度，在这道剑光面前此刻却是显得那般苍白无力。
那极致的危机感，此刻却是时刻的笼罩在它心头，它意识到这一招它躲是躲不掉了，于是它不再躲避，而是张开血盆大口，打算放手一搏。
只见它那血盆大口开始有大量的星力，快速的汇聚，没过多久便积蓄完成，接着它闭上血盆大口，旋即猛然张开。
顿时道恐怖的星力光束从它嘴中喷出，射向林轩劈来的凌厉剑光，试图将其轰散。
正是天星狼的本命神通——星辰咆哮！
眨眼间，两道攻击便碰撞在了一起，形成的恐怖的余波顿时四散开来，将此地草原方圆十里范围内的一切事物瞬间粉碎殆尽，只留下光秃秃的一片空地。
而两道攻击短暂的僵持后，林轩的那道剑光最终更胜一筹，瞬间打破了平衡，直接将天星狼的攻击从中间劈开，然后继续直直的朝着天星狼劈去。
content_en:
"No, I am not as lucky as anyone..."
Lin Xuan expressed his helplessness.
Just entering the secret realm, he didn't even have time to carefully observe the surrounding environment. He just glanced at it and found that he was in a vast plain.
However, just when he wanted to know more about this place, a black shadow rushed towards him as quickly as lightning.
roar!
Taking a closer look, he saw a huge black wolf with hair standing on end like steel needles, charging towards him with its teeth and claws.
This black wolf exuded a heart-stopping aura, and its pair of demonic eyes flashed with bloodthirsty ferocity, revealing its deep hostility towards Lin Xuan, as if it wanted to tear him into pieces immediately.
Lin Xuan: If he had such luck today, if he were allowed to go to the system to draw a lottery, he would lose all his pants...
This is a Heavenly Star Wolf of the third level of the King Realm.
The Sirius Wolf is famous for its amazing speed and powerful attack power, especially its natal magical power "Star Roar", which can release extremely powerful star power attacks.
In addition, it also has a thin bloodline of holy beasts, and may evolve into a holy beast in the holy realm in the future. Even if it fails to advance to become a holy beast, once it reaches adulthood, its strength will be comparable to that of a powerful person in the venerable realm.
It's a pity that the Star Wolf in front of Lin Xuan is obviously not yet underage, but is only at the third level of the King Realm. Although the realm is higher than Lin Xuan, it will be in bad luck if it offends Lin Xuan, and the price is... its life!
Although he was unlucky and was targeted by the big demon as soon as he entered, which made Lin Xuan helpless, he only complained a bit and his reaction was not slow at all.
After dodging the attack of the Sirius Wolf, he immediately summoned his magical weapon - Tianxuan Sword, an eighth-level top-grade weapon.
With his current strength, he is still unable to exert half of the power of the sacred weapon, but if it is a revered weapon, Lin Xuan can exert most of its power.
This is also the reason why Lin Xuan does not use the holy sword even though he does not lack it.
"Beast! Die!"
Lin Xuan gave a low shout and then struck with a sword light.
breaking Dawn!
This is one of the sword moves that Lin Xuan has learned from the Chaos Sword Technique this month.
Facing the Heavenly Star Wolf who was only at the third level of the King Realm, he did not use all his strength with this sword, not even half, but only used three points of his strength.
I saw that sword light, shining with extremely dazzling light, as if it could break through the endless chaos and illuminate the endless universe.
The sword light was extremely fast and pointed directly at the Sirius Wolf.
But at this time, the Sirius Wolf found that the speed it was usually proud of seemed so pale and weak in front of this sword light.
The ultimate sense of crisis is always shrouding its heart at this moment. It realizes that it cannot avoid this move, so it no longer avoids it, but opens its bloody mouth, planning to give it a try.
I saw that its bloody mouth began to contain a large amount of star power, which quickly gathered. It didn't take long for the accumulation to be completed. Then it closed its bloody mouth and suddenly opened it.
Suddenly, a terrifying beam of star power erupted from its mouth and shot towards Lin Xuan's sharp sword light, trying to scatter it.
It is the natal magical power of the Sirius Wolf - the Roar of the Stars!
In the blink of an eye, the two attacks collided together, and the resulting terrifying aftermath spread out in all directions, instantly shattering everything within a ten-mile radius of the grassland, leaving only a bare open space.
After a brief stalemate between the two attacks, Lin Xuan's sword light finally gained the upper hand, instantly breaking the balance and directly splitting the Star Wolf's attack from the middle, and then continued to strike straight towards the Star Wolf.
